readme:
# Polymarket Get market price API

Retrieves the best market price for a specific token ID and side (bid or ask). Returns the best bid price for BUY side or best ask price for SELL side.

The response is the official Polymarket API response, unchanged.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/polymarket/price" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"side": "BUY", "token_id": "32338220190071351435772801779725302244575775216413325951443816017994629993401"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | string | Yes | Order side |
| `token_id` | string | Yes | Token ID (asset ID) |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
